title: Ground Leakage — Elevated
description: Ground leakage current P092 = {val} mA, above advisory threshold (10 mA). Risk of nuisance RCD tripping.
probable_cause: Degraded motor winding insulation, cable damage, or moisture ingress.
diagnostic_steps: Perform insulation resistance test on all motor cables
Inspect cable entry points for moisture
Check RCD rating vs measured leakage
remedy: Locate and repair insulation fault. Replace damaged cables.
required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.
escalation_path: If ELC-SR-001 is not addressed (complete current cycle then stop. schedule maintenance within 4 hours.), the fault will escalate in this order: ELC-MJ-001, then ELC-MD-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
